calls.title: Jeremy / Luke / Kari - Exp Overview
calls.summary: The team focused on improving the experiment creation flow by reducing friction for new users within a 2-3 week timebox. Key decisions included moving configuration elements to an overview and pre-launch checklist, supporting collaborative workflows, and ensuring low engineering risk for changes. Additionally, the design for the overview page was reorganized to simplify user experience by grouping related settings and balancing clarity with completeness. They discussed a review workflow that requires lightweight confirmation of key fields and the management of custom fields to enhance clarity. UI refinements were also addressed to encourage concise entries and improve dismissibility of UI elements.
calls.keywords: experiment overview, friction reduction, creation flow, pre-launch checklist, user validation, custom fields
calls.action_items:
**Kari Kay**
Deliver mockups clarifying scope for the experiment overview redesign by mid next week or earlier if possible (10:40)
Incorporate a system to track reviewed/completed states for overview sections to reduce modal navigation and improve user flow (21:00)
Design overview page grouping of fields and blocks to enable better user focus and chunked information (24:00)
Explore UI treatments for empty states in hypothesis and description fields, including collapsible or compact views (52:00)

**Luke Sonnet**
Finalize categorization of all experiment overview fields (targeting, variations, metrics, custom fields) for grouping and readiness checklist purposes (59:00)
Organize and share updated documentation for overview page feature grouping and checklist items with Kari (59:00)
Support Kari with clarifications and prototyping discussions to reduce post-prototyping iterations (12:20)

**Michael**
Assigned as front-end engineer to implement the redesigned overview page and checklist components following design mockups (10:50)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Provide ongoing feedback on prioritization and user needs related to friction reduction and power user optimization for experiment creation (00:01)
Participate in defining minimum scope for two-to-three-week implementation that balances benefit and effort (08:30)
